bib.title: KOSMOS-2: Grounding Multimodal Large Language Models to the World

question: Can a multimodal LLM be given grounding (emit bounding boxes for text spans) and referring (accept boxes as input) abilities by training on web-scale grounded image-text pairs, without losing its language and vision-language skills?
hypothesis: Adding grounded image-text pairs, with boxes written as location tokens in a Markdown-link-like format, to KOSMOS-1 training unlocks grounding and referring while keeping general performance.
contributions: GRIT, a web-scale dataset of grounded image-text pairs built from COYO-700M and LAION-2B
KOSMOS-2, an MLLM with grounding and referring via location tokens in a 'hyperlink' format
Evaluation on phrase grounding, referring expression comprehension and generation, captioning, VQA and language tasks

method.summary:
KOSMOS-2 starts from KOSMOS-1 and continues training with next-token prediction on text, image-caption pairs, interleaved data and the new GRIT data. Bounding boxes are discretised into 32x32 location tokens added to the vocabulary and written after the text span as '

span

'. Instruction tuning follows with LLaVA-Instruct, Unnatural Instructions, FLANv2 and grounded instructions from GRIT.
method.task: next-token pretraining of a grounded multimodal LLM, then instruction tuning

datasets.name: GRIT
datasets.size: ~91M images, 115M text spans, 137M bounding boxes (Table 1: 90,614,680 images; 137,349,210 objects; 114,978,233 text spans; avg expression length 4.7)
datasets.source: subset of COYO-700M and LAION-2B; noun chunks via spaCy, boxes via GLIP; a subset is downloadable at aka.ms/kosmos-2
datasets.preprocessing: drop abstract noun phrases; NMS on boxes; keep noun-chunk-box pairs with confidence > 0.65; discard pair if no box kept; expand noun chunks into referring expressions via dependency tree (no expansion for conjuncts); keep only expressions not contained in others

datasets.name: KOSMOS-1 corpora (text corpora, image-caption pairs, interleaved image-text)
LLaVA-Instruct, Unnatural Instructions, FLANv2, grounded instruction data from GRIT
datasets.preprocessing: grounded instructions built from expression-box pairs with templates (Table 9)

datasets.name: StoryCloze, HellaSwag, Winograd, Winogrande, PIQA, BoolQ, CB, COPA

models.name: KOSMOS-2
models.architecture: vision encoder + resampler + 24-layer MAGNETO Transformer causal LM

other.all_params_updated: yes, in training and instruction tuning

training.objective: next-token prediction; loss only on discrete tokens (text and location tokens)
training.batch_size: 419K tokens: 185K text corpora, 215K original and grounded image-caption pairs, 19K interleaved; Table 7 sequences: 93 text, 1,117 caption, 1,117 grounded, 47 interleaved

other.instruction_tuning_batch: Table 8: 117 language instruction, 351 vision-language instruction, 1404 grounded pairs and grounded instruction, 30 text corpora, 15 interleaved

inference.decoding: greedy for referring expression generation and VQAv2; beam search size 5 for Flickr30k captioning
inference.prompting:
phrase grounding: preceding words as context plus '

{phrase}

'; REC: '

expression

'; REG: '

It

is' (few-shot k=2,4); captioning 'An image of'; VQA 'Question: {question} Answer: {answer}'

other.perception_language_evals_without_instru: yes, for fair comparison with KOSMOS-1

metrics.name: R@1/5/10 (Flickr30k Entities)
metrics.definition: recall over top 1/5/10 generated boxes, correct if IoU > 0.5, ANY-BOX protocol of MDETR; undecodable output counts as negative

metrics.name: Accuracy (RefCOCO/+/g)
metrics.definition: first generated box correct if IoU > 0.5

eval.protocol: zero-shot unless stated; single run, no significance tests

availability.data: a subset of GRIT at https://aka.ms/kosmos-2

results.claim: Language tasks are comparable to KOSMOS-1; BoolQ 62.0 up from 56.4, CB 30.4 down from 44.6.
Training took about 25B tokens in 60k steps on 256 V100s in about one day.
results.quote: We train KOSMOS-2 for 60k steps, equivalent to around 25 billion tokens.

limits: Evaluated mainly zero-shot; far below finetuned specialists on RefCOCO and RefCOCO+ (authors cite short expressions)
Perception-language results are without instruction tuning; instruction-tuned numbers not reported
No seeds, variance or ablation of GRIT filtering thresholds
Grounding via GLIP pseudo-labels with confidence > 0.65; label noise not quantified
Boxes only, quantised to 32x32 bins at 224x224 input
No quantitative evaluation of grounded VQA or captioning (qualitative figures only)

terms.definition: P x P discrete tokens, one per bin of the image, added to the word vocabulary to encode box corners
Grounded Image-Text pairs dataset built from COYO-700M and LAION-2B
